SUMMARY Certified Professional with 8+ years of experience across Telecommunication and Enterprise environments,

raw_sections.experience:
EXPERIENCE Network Engineer Cisco system (LTI mindtree) | Bangalore I Jan 2025-Current
Working as a Network Enterprise Engineer at Cisco, supporting the Morgan Stanley enterprise network
infrastructure.
Led network device refresh projects for Morgan Stanley, replacing legacy switches with new-generation
Nexus, Catalyst, and Arista switches across enterprise and data center environments.
Performed configuration analysis and migration from legacy platforms to new switches, ensuring feature parity, and compliance with enterprise standards.
Hands-on experience with Cisco Nexus (9K/7K) and Catalyst (9K/3K) platforms for core, distribution,
and access layers.
Administer and manage Palo Alto Networks firewalls (PAN-OS) across enterprise environments,
ensuring high availability and security compliance
Deploy and support GlobalProtect VPN for secure remote access, including troubleshooting connectivity and implement and manage IPSec site-to-site VPNs and ensure secure communication between branch offices
Configured and managed High Availability (HA) Active/Passive and Active/Active setups on Palo Alto
firewalls to ensure zero/minimal downtime
Sr. Network Engineer
Tata communications I Chennai, India I May 2023-Dec 2024
Planning and preparing the MOP, SOP, and performing the change management activities of the BNG
internet gateway and MPLS core links.
Configure and deploying designed network solutions at ISP Gateway level within IP Routing, MPLS/BGP
environment. (Uplink and downlink)
Configure and maintain the EBGP routing protocol in BNG to advertise broadband users' routes to the
Internet gateway.
Configuring and maintaining the DHCP, PPPoE, and lPoE protocols for establishing broadband
subscriber sessions in BNG.
Configuring and troubleshooting networking technologies, including MPLS, L2VPN, VRF, and BGP, OSPF protocols, working within an ISP/Telecoms service provider environment. (Multi-vendor scenario) Having good working experience in Cisco ASR9000, NCS540, ASR900, Juniper MX960, MX460, Nokia
7750, and IXRE device.
Executive in NOC IP Core Network
Bharti Airtel I Chennai, India I May 2019-Apr 2023
Planning, Configuring, and testing the Broadband-related New Data and P2P services.
Maintaining the Network Traffic Utilization Report and Optimizing the Traffic Utilization based on the Network Capacity.
Performing the network switchover activities and ensuring redundancy in the core and aggregation links. Coordinating with multiple third-party network teams to implement the new NNI and aggregation links to the new location implementation.
Providing excellent change management support and timely closing the activity on the given outage
window.
Network Engineer
Atria Convergence Technologies Private Limited I Chennai, India I Sep 2016-Nov 2017 Configuring and troubleshooting Wireless modems, Extenders and Y/iFi routers
Planning and implementing the network connectivity using copper and fiber cables (4F and 12 and 24F)
Detecting fiber cable network outages using OTDR and generating the fault reports
Providing the support to the backend NOC technical team to resolve nodes hardware outages
Maintaining the Area cluster rooms with Proper power backup sources and Temperature control with
help of infrastructure maintenance Team
